title: 경기도 수원시와 용인시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 경기도 수원시와 용인시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 1 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do) Lot Nos. 182-1, 182-5, 279-1, 283-1, 283-2, 283-4, 284-3, 284-4, 284-9 through 284-11, 286-4, 423-1, 424, 425, 599, 601, 601-1 through 601-9, 602, 603, and 603-1 through 603-11 in Woncheon-dong, Yeongtong-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do shall be excluded from the jurisdictional area of Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and incorporated into the jurisdictional area of Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do.
